description: Read endpoints the builder UI needs to populate pickers: GET /api/pokemon/{id}/moves (species' legal learnset with move name, type, damage class, power/pp/accuracy, learn method/level), GET /api/pokemon/{id}/abilities (already have relationship — expose incl. is_hidden), GET /api/natures (all natures with increased/decreased stat). Reuse pokemon_query service patterns and sprite/type helpers. Support name search/filter for the move picker.
title: Builder lookup API: legal moves, abilities, natures
